Nyanihongo {{VERSION}}: a kawaii Japanese-learning app for Windows and Android, with English, French, Spanish and Chinese interfaces.

| Download | For |
|---|---|
| `Nyanihongo-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe` | Windows installer |
| `Nyanihongo-{{VERSION}}.apk` | Android, install by hand |

**Windows:** the installer isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn you. Choose More info, then Run anyway.

**Android:** this is a debug build and hasn't been tested on a real phone yet. Your phone may ask you to allow installs from this source.

Lessons work offline. Photo and video links need a connection, and audio needs a Japanese text-to-speech voice on the device.
